an4.89:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti?
an4.89:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā-diṭṭhiko hoti sammāsaṅkappo hoti sammāvāco hoti sammā-kammanto hoti sammā-ājīvo hoti sammā-vāyāmo hoti sammā-sati hoti sammā-samādhi hoti.
an4.89:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti. 3.
an4.89:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍarīko hoti?
an4.89:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā-diṭṭhiko hoti . . . pe . . . sammā-samādhi hoti sammā-ñāṇī hoti sammāvimutti hoti, no ca kho aṭṭha vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an4.89:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍariko hoti. 4.
an4.89:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti?
an4.89:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā-diṭṭhiko hoti . . . pe . . . sammā-vimutti hoti aṭṭha vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an4.89:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti. 5.
an4.89:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo hoti?
an4.89:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yācito bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito . . . pe . . . [87. 6.] Yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti mam eva taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti.
an4.89:5.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamāna lokasmin ti. 90. 1.
